claim_tested: CANSDC/CASDC family has a diagnostic active site distinct from DAPDC
key_finding: Leu314 replaces the acidic residue that binds the distal amine in DAPDC/ODC/ADC; PLP Schiff base at Lys41
context: Campylobacter jejuni, recombinant enzyme + product complex
confidence_and_limitations: High for the family signature; the complex holds norspermidine, not a carboxylated substrate

claim_tested: Which polyamine the CANSDC-family enzyme actually makes in vivo
key_finding: The C. jejuni CANSDC orthologue makes spermidine, not sym-norspermidine, in vivo
confidence_and_limitations: High; shows the same pocket turns over both 3-3 and 4-3 substrates, so the name is misleading

claim_tested: BT_0674 is required for spermidine synthesis in B. thetaiotaomicron
key_finding: casdc deletion depletes spermidine and abolishes decarboxylase activity
confidence_and_limitations: High for pathway role; abstract-level only, no kinetic constants

claim_tested: Where chain-length selection sits in CASDC
key_finding: beta6/beta7 flap loop and the alpha9 helix are proposed to select substrates by chain length
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; the selection model is proposed from apo structures, not tested kinetically

claim_tested: Which enzyme of the pair sets product identity
key_finding: Spm/Tspm production is controlled primarily by carboxyspermidine dehydrogenase, not carboxyspermidine decarboxylase
confidence_and_limitations: High; directly contradicts a decarboxylase-centred selectivity model

claim_tested: Which diamine initiates the route in Bacteroides
key_finding: Bacteroides homologues of the dehydrogenase strongly prefer agmatine, acting as carboxyaminopropylagmatine dehydrogenases
confidence_and_limitations: High; applies to BT_4612 (96.7% identical to the B. fragilis enzyme), not to BT_0674

claim_tested: The dehydrogenase step uses putrescine and NADPH
key_finding: Putrescine is the likely polyamine substrate and NADPH the coenzyme, forming carboxyspermidine
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; organism-dependent and in tension with PMID:42754158

claim_tested: A Bacteroides CASDC structure exists and matches BT_0674
key_finding: Deposited as carboxyaminopropylagmatine decarboxylase from B. fragilis, 91.3% identical to BT_0674, apo
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; unpublished deposition, apo, the title asserts a substrate the coordinates do not demonstrate

claim_tested: BT_0674 is the decarboxylase step with a complete catalytic apparatus
key_finding: 13 of 14 active-site positions identical to 3N29; Lys42 Schiff base, Glu239, Gly206-Gly207, His171, Asp279, Leu310, Tyr338, Lys342, Phe346 all present; 23.4% identity to lysA with Glu at the Leu314 position in both true DAPDCs
context: Sequence and PDB coordinates, no wet-lab data
confidence_and_limitations: High for presence/absence of residues; inference only for activity

claim_tested: Whether the pocket constrains substrate choice
key_finding: The only Bacteroidota-specific change, Glu236 to Ser242, withdraws one H-bond (4.10 A vs 2.54 A) and changes computed cavity volume by 0 A^3 on in-silico truncation
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate-high; the Bacteroides structure is apo and no ligand complex or kinetics exist

key_finding: Zero PF01564 (speE) and zero PF02675 (speD) proteins in taxon 226186; one CASDH (BT_4612), one CASDC (BT_0674), one authentic lysA (BT_1374)
confidence_and_limitations: High; proteome-level absence, dependent on current annotation completeness

claim_tested: Whether existing GO terms on Q8A9Z1 rest on experiment
key_finding: All 5 annotation lines on Q8A9Z1 are IEA or IBA; GO:0008836 and GO:0009085 are IBA from PANTHER node PTN000159906 with the same withFrom set as the authentic lysA Q8A800
